mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as the market anticipates accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2% over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal a tightening monetary policy cycle amid rising inflation, which increases real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL increase by at least 0.1% and 0.5% respectively over the prior month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 210), a high level of employment (PAYEMS > 129,000) signals robust consumer demand and corporate pricing power, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 210 and PAYEMS > 129,000 over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 100.5 signals strong manufacturing activity and corporate capacity utilization, which supports earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 100.5 over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 560 thousand indicates strong residential construction and consumer confidence, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 560 over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of employment (PAYEMS) directly supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as the labor market strengthens.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 129,000 over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous levels of consumer spending (RSAFS) above 350,000 and housing starts (HOUST) above 550 signal strong household demand and economic momentum, which drives positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 350000 and HOUST > 550 over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.
